method: Creator picks, technical levels, option-flow and momentum calls are zero-weight discovery inputs. Tickers are normalized only where identity is sufficiently clear; company filings, official releases and current market data determine Power Stack verdicts and any promotion.
regime: Refined-product/shipping scarcity + restrictive long-end yields + weak breadth + record physical AI/power demand. Prefer cash-generative scarcity and proven operating demand over leveraged duration; use creator shorts as stress tests rather than automatic bearish calls.

verdicts.name: Advanced Micro Devices
verdicts.verdict: PROMOTE TO PRIORITY SELECTIVE RESEARCH / RETEST
verdicts.fit: Strong operating AI proof, but valuation and duration sensitivity are high
verdicts.independentRead: Q2 Data Center revenue was $6.7B, up 107% YoY, with $2.1B Data Center operating income. AMD ended Q2 with $13.1B of cash and short-term investments versus about $3.2B of debt. The company itself frames the 2030 AI opportunity at about $2T; the creator's $2T-$3T range is not retained.
verdicts.currentContext: Shares have already rebounded sharply and were trading above $500 in the latest session. The operating thesis is stronger than a momentum-only call, but the current 4.8%+ 10Y / elevated AI-funding-risk regime argues against chasing a multi-day surge.
verdicts.action: Add to priority watch/research. Require an orderly retest or consolidation and continued MI/EPYC order, margin and cash-conversion proof rather than buying solely on a breakout level.
verdicts.risks: Premium valuation, export controls, Nvidia/custom-ASIC competition, customer concentration, MI450/Helios execution and broader AI-capex funding stress.

verdicts.name: Wells Fargo
verdicts.fit: Good higher-for-longer fit while credit and funding remain controlled
verdicts.independentRead: This was already independently promoted by Power Stack on Sep 3. Q2 NII was $12.3B, up 5% YoY; net income was about $6.4B, average loans and deposits increased materially, and credit indicators remained controlled. The Sep 9 close was about $89.67 after a 1.94% gain.
verdicts.action: Restore/reconfirm in the active selective queue. Do not treat higher yields as automatically bullish: require NII durability, manageable deposit beta and no material deterioration in consumer/CRE credit.
verdicts.risks: 10Y approaching 5% can eventually damage loan demand, housing/CRE and borrower credit; deposit competition and charge-offs are the key inversion risks.

verdicts.name: Royal Caribbean Group
verdicts.verdict: NEGATIVE-SENSITIVITY MONITOR / NOT A FUNDAMENTAL SHORT
verdicts.fit: Fuel, inflation and consumer-duration headwinds are real, but company execution remains stronger than the creator framing implies
verdicts.independentRead: Royal Caribbean beat Q2 expectations and raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $17.73-$17.87 on strong close-in demand, lower costs and favorable JV performance. The Sep 9 close was about $259.76 after an 11-session losing streak, so the tape is weak but the operating evidence does not justify a high-conviction fundamental short.
verdicts.action: Use RCL as a consumer/fuel-stress diagnostic. Avoid chasing the long side while oil/product inflation and yields remain elevated, but require booking/yield/margin deterioration before escalating a bearish thesis.
verdicts.risks: A durable oil decline, resilient high-income travel demand or continued cost execution can invalidate the macro bear case.

verdicts.name: NANO Nuclear Energy
verdicts.verdict: AVOID CORE LONG / VENTURE-RESEARCH ONLY; DO NOT LABEL FUNDAMENTAL SHORT
verdicts.fit: Pre-commercial nuclear conflicts with high real yields, but balance-sheet liquidity materially reduces near-term financing risk
verdicts.independentRead: NANO ended its fiscal Q3 with about $580M in cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments and has NRC acceptance of the KRONOS construction-permit application. Commercial reactor economics and construction are still future-dated, so Power Stack continues to prefer CCJ/BWXT/CW and operating generation.
verdicts.currentContext: NNE closed Sep 9 around $18.17, down 6.1%, close to the creator's tactical downside trigger.
verdicts.action: No core promotion. Treat downside momentum as tactical only; monitor NRC milestones, cash burn and project/customer economics.
verdicts.risks: Long development timeline, dilution/execution, licensing and project economics; counter-risk is unusually large liquidity for a pre-commercial nuclear name.

verdicts.name: Ondas Holdings
verdicts.verdict: HIGH-GROWTH DEFENSE/AUTONOMY RESEARCH / WAIT FOR PROFIT CONVERSION
verdicts.fit: Strong backlog/order growth but acquisition-heavy, loss-making and high-beta
verdicts.independentRead: Q2 revenue reached $83.8M versus $6.3M a year earlier; reported backlog was about $613M and pro-forma backlog $757M including DZYNE/Cyberhawk. The company had about $1.4B of cash/restricted cash/short-term investments at Jun 30, but the buildout is acquisition-heavy and company-wide adjusted EBITDA profitability is targeted only for Q4 2027.
verdicts.currentContext: ONDS closed Sep 9 around $7.29 with a $7.26 intraday low, which is why 'Andis below $7.25' is likely this ticker.
verdicts.action: Do not adopt the creator downside call as a fundamental short. Keep as a research candidate and require organic backlog conversion, margin repair, integration discipline and eventual FCF proof before promotion.
verdicts.risks: Acquisition integration, operating losses, stock-based compensation/dilution, defense-order timing and backlog quality.

rankingAmongActionableCreatorIdeas.action: PROMOTE TO PRIORITY SELECTIVE RESEARCH / RETEST

themeReadThrough: AMD strengthens the AI-compute operating-demand side of the physical-buildout thesis, but also reinforces the need to distinguish supplier revenue/cash conversion from hyperscaler financing quality.
WFC gives the Duration theme an important two-sided transmission: moderately higher rates can support bank NII, while excessively high long yields eventually damage credit and loan demand.
RCL is a useful real-economy stress monitor for the Products/Shipping + Consumer Credit themes because fuel and financing costs can compress discretionary travel economics.
NNE is a useful negative control for the nuclear theme: strategic nuclear demand does not automatically make pre-commercial project-duration equities attractive.
ONDS suggests defense/autonomy deserves continued adjacent research, but acquisition-funded growth and profitability conversion must be separated from headline backlog.
